activities.title: Autoregressive Sampling: Greedy Decoding vs Temperature Scaling

source_resources.title: The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration
source_resources.author: Ari Holtzman, Jan Buys, Li Du, Maxwell Forbes, Yejin Choi
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful academic reference under arXiv open access terms.
source_resources.prerequisites: Softmax probabilities, cumulative probability distributions from Days 25-27 and 41-42.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Primary source introducing Nucleus (Top-p) sampling and analyzing the failure of greedy decoding (loops, repetition).
source_resources.safe_fallback: Top-p truncation algorithms and worked probability cutoffs are completely explained in the lesson.

compared_candidates.candidate_name: Fan et al. Hierarchical Neural Story Generation (Top-k)
compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: Introduces top-k sampling; Holtzman et al. dynamic nucleus threshold is compared directly against top-k.
Practical library guide; Holtzman provides the foundational mathematical reasoning.

source_resources.relevant_timestamp: Section 2.1 Text Generation Decoding Strategies and Section 3.3 Sampling with Temperature

source_resources.title: nanoGPT: sample.py autoregressive generation script
source_resources.author: Andrej Karpathy
source_resources.permission_basis: Lawful external reference under MIT license.
source_resources.prerequisites: PyTorch inference, torch.multinomial, and Day 48 decoder-only forward pass.
source_resources.selection_rationale: Compact historical code reference for the named implementation functions; CS336 spring2025 provides the lead component exercises. Do not infer top-p, atomic persistence or cloud budget enforcement from nanoGPT.

compared_candidates.comparison_rationale: C++ implementation with high performance; nanoGPT is readable Python matched to our curriculum.
Encoder-decoder model; nanoGPT decoder-only autoregressive loop is the direct fit for modern LLMs.

source_resources.known_availability_limitations: Historical implementation reference: nanoGPT README marks the repository deprecated (November 2025). Toy CPU reading/runs do not establish full GPU pretraining feasibility.
source_resources.safe_fallback: The generation loop is implemented in runnable local scripts.
source_resources.relevant_timestamp: sample.py: temperature and top_k settings passed to model.generate (model.py: GPT.generate)
